baseline.name: Generate every bracket string and validate
baseline.approach: Enumerate all length-2n strings over two bracket choices, then check balance.
baseline.space: O(n) working space plus valid output

archived.name: Prefix-valid backtracking
archived.time: O(n*C_n), where C_n is the nth Catalan number
archived.space: O(n) working/recursion plus O(n*C_n) output and a fixed 1500-pointer table

why: The open/close constraints reject invalid prefixes before constructing their remaining suffixes.
quantitative_comparison: At n=8 the exhaustive baseline considers 65536 complete bracket strings, while 1430 valid strings must be emitted. The archive prunes invalid prefixes; these candidate/output counts are not an elapsed-time ratio.
tradeoffs: The archive still has unavoidable exponential output and relies on n<=8 for its fixed result capacity. Allocation failures are unchecked; small n need not yield a measurable speed advantage.
evidence_basis: Static source/invariant comparison with an explicitly defined exhaustive baseline; no matched runtime benchmark was run.
